collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-17  -  THE APPRENTICE'S ERROR SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A healer's apprentice mixes up two storage labels before any medicine has been prepared.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A healer's apprentice mixes up two storage labels before any medicine has been prepared.

choices.label: Compare the containers with the written records.
Ask another apprentice to check the labels independently.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The labels are corrected, and the apprentice learns a safer checking routine.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The healer temporarily removes the apprentice from preparation duties until the containers are verified.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The apprentice identifies the mistake and asks the healer to confirm the correction.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The records are unclear, so both containers are set aside for inspection.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The second apprentice catches the mismatch and helps prevent confusion.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The apprentices disagree, so they seek the healer's judgment before proceeding.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The healer adopts a simple method that makes similar containers easier to distinguish.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The proposal needs refinement, but the healer welcomes the apprentice's attention to safety.
